caption:
Gallup says quiet quitting is rising in India. The headlines will call it laziness. It isn't.

Most of the people pulling back are the ones who carried the load. They briefed well. They delivered. And they watched their idea get ignored until a louder voice repeated it back to the room.

Withdrawal is what competence does when it stops being heard. You don't fix that with another engagement survey. You fix it by being impossible to talk over.

That starts with bearing. How you sit. How you hold the pause before you answer. Calculated silence does more in a boardroom than three minutes of justification ever will.

Thirty-five years of command taught Colonel Suhag one thing above all: authority is carried, not granted. You stop waiting to be recognised and you start occupying the room.

The work is still yours. Make sure the credit is too.
